thread:
alex_support: Hey team — customer (acme-inc) reports sudden 429s after switching from free -> paid yesterday. They said traffic pattern didn't change, just higher concurrency. Posting repro and headers.

alex_support: Repro steps: curl against /v1/generate with 30 concurrent requests, short prompts. Getting 429 with body: '{\"error\":{\"message\":\"Rate limit exceeded\"}}' and headers: x-rate-limit-limit: 60, x-rate-limit-remaining: 0, x-rate-limit-reset: 24, x-request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d.

alex_support: Request is urgent — customer demo tomorrow. They purchased paid seats but expected higher concurrency than free tier. Can we do a temporary burst or quick plan clarification? cc @sam_sales

clare_billing: Thanks for the detail. Which paid plan did they move to (Starter/Pro/Enterprise)? billing shows invoice id INV-3742 but need tier name to confirm quota.

alex_support: They bought "Pro monthly" via sales rep on Friday. Account id acct_5678. I can share the customer email if needed.

sam_sales: Got it. I spoke to them last week — they thought Pro includes 200 concurrent tokens/s, but our docs say Pro is 60 rps by default. We can offer a short-term burst (sales-assisted) for demo windows. I need support + billing signoff.

ravi_eng: From runtime side: 429 means they hit the per-account concurrency limiter. We throttle aggressively to protect multi-tenant capacity. Quick mitigation: enable smaller connection pools and client-side retries with exponential backoff. Also can configure a 15s grace burst if ops approves.

alex_support: Customer tried retry-after but their clients are non-idempotent. They control the client code but timeline is tight. Can we temporarily increase concurrency for acct_5678 for 24h?

clare_billing: We can do a one-off quota override if finance ok. I need the CSR (customer signed order) and billing contact. Is this affecting invoicing?

sam_sales: I'll attach order; they're on a trial invoice and signed the MSA. Approve from sales to cover overage for 24h.

ravi_eng: Ops-bot, can you create temp quota change? If not, I'll run the patch to bump their concurrency cap to 240 for 24 hours and monitor.

ops-bot: @ravi_eng Request logged: OT-9042. Automated guardrails warn: increasing per-tenant concurrency may impact host pool. Proceed with manual opt-in.

ravi_eng: Understood. I'll do a controlled bump and add a route rule to divert excess to a cheaper model variant if we see sustained pressure. Plan: bump to 240 for 24h, enable KV prefix caching for their common prompts, and enable fallback to small-llm-v2 when latency spike > 1s.

alex_support: Thanks — please post the exact command or UI steps so I can confirm with customer. Also, what's the expected headers they'll see so they know it's temporary?

ravi_eng: Action steps (internal):
1) Admin console -> Accounts -> acct_5678 -> Quotas -> set concurrency_limit = 240, expiry = now + 24h
2) Add routing policy: acct_5678 -> fallback_model = small-llm-v2 when p95 latency > 1000ms
3) Monitor token throughput and set alert if cluster CPU > 70% for 10m

ravi_eng: Expected response headers after change: x-rate-limit-limit: 240, x-rate-limit-remaining: <value>, x-rate-limit-reset: <secs>. If they still hit 429s, collect x-request-id and sample request bodies, we'll trace.

clare_billing: Approved for 24h burst. Logged in finance: FIN-1129. Please include note to revert after 24h.

sam_sales: I'll tell the customer: temporary bump approved for 24h, working on longer-term upgrade to Dedicated if they need sustained throughput.

alex_support: Customer notified and grateful. Will post back after demo. If they accept Dedicated, what's the rough lead time?

ravi_eng: Dedicated provisioning ~2-4 weeks depending on region and capacity. We can expedite via committed reserved capacity. I'll loop infra if they want faster.

ops-bot: OT-9042 status: quota bump applied by ravi_eng at 1773030365, expires at 1773116765.

alex_support: Confirmed — customer seeing x-rate-limit-limit: 240 now, demo passed. Leaving this thread open for post-mortem and docs update.

clare_billing: Will follow up on invoicing for the overage. Also recommend we add clearer plan concurrency numbers in the billing page and the pricing FAQ.

sam_sales: Agreed — I'll update the sales playbook and attach a template for "24h burst" approvals to speed future requests.

ravi_eng: Post-mortem action items: 1) Make per-plan concurrency explicit in docs, 2) add self-serve burst request in console with SLA guardrails, 3) add metric link for easy triage in support flows.

alex_support: Great. Closing once billing confirms. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
